text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing, Bright...
The first-ever 'back-to-back Queen Elizabeth II Cup' victory in Mejiro history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Normally I'd have wanted to achieve it first.
But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Bright.
Well... you're undeniably the queen now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's the title I wanted most of all,
but I'll concede it this time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~
After all, an umamusume of the Mejiro family... simply must pursue it, you know~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: —The Queen of the Mejiros. She who shone as the first ever to claim the Triple Tiara in Umamusume history... Lady Ramonu's greatest achievement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if we got a little closer~.
Even if we did, though~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The title of "Queen" might not suit me
very well, don't you think~?
It just doesn't feel like me at all~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Really? I actually think it suits Bright
pretty well, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you do something for the fans?
Something befitting a queen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dear fans~. Thank you all so very much
for honoring me as queen~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
In return, the Mejiro family has
a wo~nderful gift for you~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: As for my reward as a queen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'll think of something now~.
So please wait just a moment~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Bright!?
You hadn't thought about it at all?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I wasn't thinking about it at all~
I was just, you know, planning to think about it now~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you weren't thinking at all.
Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No problem, no problem.
I'll come up with an idea, Bright, so you
just tell me if it sounds good to you or not.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. Then all that's left for me
is to say this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "Do as you see fit~." I'm so happy you're taking care of things for me, Dober~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... She's not exactly someone you can lean on,
but maybe that just makes her feel more like a queen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It makes me feel like I, as the one supporting her,
need to do my best too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Pardon me~, sorry to trouble you~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“Still... if I had to say, Dober is the one
more suited to be queen, though.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I won't deny that, though. Of course, I'm gonna aim to be a queen in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I won't let you sit in that seat forever. Accept my challenge next year, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, of course~.
Do as you see fit~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright smiles warmly.
And thus, ahead of Mejiro Dober, she inherited the throne as the queen of the Mejiro family.
